convert_points_from_homogeneous: remove the homogeneous dimension from N-dimensional points by dividing by the last coordinate
undistort_camera_points: undistort 2D camera points using radial and tangential distortion coefficients with validity masking
review_geometry_undistort: review the undistort_points function to understand the radial and tangential distortion model and inflection point logic
summarize_homogeneous_conversions: summarize the from_homogeneous and to_homogeneous functions for converting between Euclidean and homogeneous coordinates
